SSM GLM-HMM safety check (2AFC)

Fits a K-state GLM-HMM using the SSM library (input_driven_obs, standard transitions) with the exact same covariates as the custom model.

SSM GLM-HMM fit summary

Log-likelihood comparison

  • Compared on 28 subject(s) and 387200 trials.
  • Custom / Dynamax total raw LL: -167998.521
  • SSM total raw LL: -168007.473
  • Δ raw LL (SSM - custom): -8.952
  • Custom / Dynamax LL per trial: -0.433880
  • SSM LL per trial: -0.433904
  • Δ LL per trial (SSM - custom): -0.000023
  • raw_ll is the data log-likelihood from the saved custom fit metrics.
  • delta columns are defined as SSM - custom / Dynamax.
  • Emission coefficients are compared after each model's states are reordered by the notebook's semantic state labelling (state_idx_order), not by raw fitted state index.

Emission coefficients — SSM vs Dynamax

Each row below is one fitted emission coefficient for one subject, aligned by the notebook's state order. delta_ssm_minus_dynamax > 0 means the SSM coefficient is larger.
